about_the_game:
Bend the Rules of Gravity

Using your rotation abilities, navigate through rooms filled with countless creative puzzles by walking along walls, ceilings, and from unusual angles.

Every Room is a New Perspective

This journey will take you to unique rooms. Here, not only your intelligence but also your sense of direction will be tested. Each section will offer a new mechanic, each corner a new perspective. Nothing is as it seems in Flipside.

Retro Meets Modern in a Pixel World

Flipside features a vibrant pixel-art atmosphere enhanced by smooth animations and subtle lighting effects. Retro visuals meet modern design in a world that feels both nostalgic and fresh.

Countless Challenges, Never Repeated

With a wide variety of handcrafted levels, Flipside delivers an evolving challenge that keeps your brain engaged. Each stage introduces new ways to play, and no two puzzles feel the same.

Get ready to flip your world. Coming soon…

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 or AMD HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Rotate entire rooms, shift your perspective, and reshape the way you think. Flipside offers a mind-twisting puzzle experience where every time you rotate the screen, reality flips in unexpected ways.
